import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Hundebestand Analyse', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Distribution of dog age
age_counts = df.groupby('AlterVHundLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_index()
axes[0, 0].bar(range(len(age_counts)), age_counts.values, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Hundealter', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Anzahl Hunde', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Verteilung nach Hundealter')
axes[0, 0].set_xticks(range(len(age_counts)))
axes[0, 0].set_xticklabels(age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
axes[0, 0].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Dogs by district (Kreis)
kreis_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
axes[0, 1].barh(kreis_counts.index, kreis_counts.values, color='coral', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Anzahl Hunde', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Kreis', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Verteilung nach Kreis')
axes[0, 1].grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Top dog breeds
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
axes[1, 0].barh(range(len(breed_counts)), breed_counts.values, color='lightgreen', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
axes[1, 0].set_yticks(range(len(breed_counts)))
axes[1, 0].set_yticklabels(breed_counts.index)
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Anzahl Hunde', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Hunderasse', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Top 10 Hunderassen')
axes[1, 0].invert_yaxis()
axes[1, 0].grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Time series: Dogs over years
yearly_counts = df.groupby('StichtagDatJahr')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_index()
axes[1, 1].plot(yearly_counts.index, yearly_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='purple')
axes[1, 1].fill_between(yearly_counts.index, yearly_counts.values, alpha=0.3, color='purple')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Jahr', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Anzahl Hunde', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Entwicklung über die Jahre')
axes[1, 1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(yearly_counts.index)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
